Whole units, the way Chalkline expects one to look. Each one has its slides, its printables (each also a loose sheet, with an answer key in the teacher edition), and its packet: an A3-folded booklet with a cover, contents and a teacher edition.

**To start your own unit from one:** copy its folder (in `course/guide/02-chalkline/examples/` after a teacher build, or `guide/examples/` in Chalkline) into `course/units/`, rename it, and change its words. In its `index.qmd`, change the title, the unit number and the objectives.

| Unit | Shows you |
|---|---|
| [**Angles**](example-angles/index.qmd) | A math lesson deck, an interactive page, a worksheet and homework with answers, a small packet |
| [**Ancient Rome**](example-rome/index.qmd) | Four history decks, and a 36-page packet with every kind of page: feature spread, glossed reading, word and language pages, readings with questions, a landscape chart, math, a timeline spread, organizers, a self-check |
| [**Mesopotamia**](example-mesopotamia/index.qmd) | Primary sources with numbered markers, investigations, a design challenge, a short-answer test with marks, a paragraph task with a rubric |
